definitions.aggregation_unit: one scenario-method terminal record; method means include all 100 terminals
definitions.completion: true iff status is SUCCESS in the V1 runner
definitions.progress_m: initial Euclidean goal distance minus final Euclidean goal distance; early terminals retain zero or any pre-terminal displacement
definitions.success: status == SUCCESS; identical to V1 completion
definitions.terminal_state: one mutually exclusive final status per run

explanations.m0_qp_infeasible_80: One first-step QP_INFEASIBLE event in each G1-G4 scenario; 80 scenario-method terminal records.
explanations.m1_m4_60_qp_plus_20_rejected: G2's 20 states terminate in Start-Safe before QP; G1, G3 and G4 contribute 60 first-step QP_INFEASIBLE terminals.
explanations.progress_population: All 100 terminal records per method, including rejected and infeasible runs, are included.
explanations.twenty_completions: Only the 20 G0 scenarios reached SUCCESS for every method.
